title: Actor
description: A creature's game data (actors/<id>, saves/<campaign>/actors/<id>.json; the same id as its token). The ruleset's own schema (rulesets/<id>/schemas/actor.schema.json) checks the rest. See docs/design/game-data.md.

base.description: A stat block in the content (creature/rat, or pathfinder-monster-core:creature/goblin-warrior naming the source): this creature is that, with its own differences.
